outline: 1.簡介 2.二極體 3. 雙極性接面電晶體(BJT) 4. 場效電晶體(FET) 5.金屬氧化物半導體場效電晶體(MOSFET) 6.線性電路 7. 運算放大器 8.數位電路
schedule:
1. Semiconductor Diodes
2. Diode Applications
3. Bipolar Junction Transistors
4-5. BJT DC Biasing
6. Midterm 1
7. Field-Effect Transistors
8-9. FET Biasing
10-11. BJT AC Analysis
12. Midterm 2
13. Frequency Response
14. Two-Port System Approach
15. Operational Amplifiers
16. Final/Digital Electronics and Circuits
17-18. Digital Electronics and Circuits and Extra Test

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
